title: 墨尔本 13 个景点容量公开资料核查
scope: Search of official venue/operator/city/state tourism sources; no operator enquiry sent.
conclusion: 7 attractions have public capacity-related figures, mostly event/room/seating configurations. No comparable verified whole-attraction design occupancy series for all 13.
metric_warning: Street sensor passages per hour are not simultaneous occupants of a venue. These capacity records are not used in the app classification.

records.name: State Library Victoria
records.app_visit_scope: Public visitor spaces in the library; the front lawn is excluded from this attraction record.
records.scope_zh: 馆内公共参观空间；不包括门前草坪
records.summary_zh: La Trobe Reading Room：站立酒会 520 人。

sources.title: State Library Victoria · La Trobe Reading Room

records.limitations_zh: 单间阅览室的活动租赁人数，不能代替整座图书馆或日常阅读空间容量。

records.name: The Ian Potter Centre: NGV Australia
records.app_visit_scope: NGV Australia at Federation Square; NGV International on St Kilda Road is excluded.
records.scope_zh: Federation Square 的 NGV Australia；不包括 St Kilda Road 的 NGV International
records.summary_zh: 未找到对应馆舍公开、可核实的整体设计容纳上限。

sources.title: City of Melbourne · Ian Potter Centre

records.limitations_zh: 官方现行租赁页指向 NGV International。Gandel Hall / Great Hall、Monash 的 Ian Potter Centre、附近餐饮场所的容量均不适用于本景点。

records.name: ACMI
records.app_visit_scope: ACMI public exhibition spaces; individual exhibitions and events require separate checking.
records.scope_zh: 公共展览空间；具体展览与活动空间需单独界定
records.summary_zh: Underground Gallery：站立 700 人／坐席 400 人；Lightwell：站立 450 人。
records.limitations_zh: 均为指定空间的活动布置；展览装置会改变可用面积。不得把各空间上限简单相加当作全馆上限。

records.name: Immigration Museum
records.scope_zh: 400 Flinders Street 的博物馆公共空间
records.summary_zh: Long Room：酒会 300、宴会 200、剧院式 150 人；庭院：酒会 750、宴会 150 人。

sources.title: Museums Victoria · Immigration Museum venue hire

records.limitations_zh: 室内 Long Room 与室外庭院是不同空间。不能将庭院数字当作室内展厅或整馆容量，也不能直接相加。

records.name: St Paul's Cathedral
records.app_visit_scope: Primarily the cathedral interior; worship and event times require separate checking.
records.scope_zh: 教堂主要室内参观空间
records.summary_zh: 固定长椅座位 900；加椅约 1,000 人。
records.limitations_zh: 官方场地租赁页公布的坐席配置，范围接近主教堂，但并非已核验的消防占用人数或日常站立参观舒适容量。

records.name: Queen Victoria Market
records.app_visit_scope: Public market spaces and covered market passages; surrounding streets are not all included.
records.summary_zh: The Sheds：酒会 10,000 人／宴会 3,000 人。
records.limitations_zh: 数字来自商户收摊后的活动场地租赁条件；日常营业时摊位与通道占用不同，不能当作购物市场的通常承载力。

records.name: Royal Arcade
records.app_visit_scope: Public arcade passage; shops are not separate attractions.
records.scope_zh: 公共拱廊通道；商店内部不单独纳入
records.summary_zh: 未找到公共通道整体的官方人数上限。
records.limitations_zh: 已检索管理方网站与官方旅游介绍。导览团人数、店铺座位和相似名称的剧院容量均不能替代拱廊容量。

records.name: The Block Arcade
records.app_visit_scope: Public arcade passage; shops are not separate attractions.
records.summary_zh: Collins Street 穹顶下活动空间：坐席 150／站立 250 人。
records.limitations_zh: 官方说明活动安排在营业时间之后。该活动空间人数不代表全拱廊日常购物通道上限。

records.name: Bourke Street Mall
records.app_visit_scope: Bourke Street between Swanston and Elizabeth Streets; department-store interiors are excluded.
records.scope_zh: Swanston Street 至 Elizabeth Street；不含百货商场内部
records.summary_zh: 未找到对应户外步行区公开核定人数。
records.limitations_zh: 这里同时通行电车与行人，需明确可用行人面积、轨道与疏散通道。周边酒店、商场、餐饮座位和整个商业片区统计均不适用。

records.name: Chinatown (Little Bourke Street)
records.app_visit_scope: Little Bourke Street between Swanston and Exhibition Streets; restaurants are not separate attractions.
records.scope_zh: 本软件记录的 Swanston Street 至 Exhibition Street 街段
records.summary_zh: 未找到该街段整体的官方容纳上限。
records.limitations_zh: 餐厅和博物馆容量不等于街道容量；节庆封路后的活动范围也可能不同。宣传中的 Chinatown 地理范围较软件街段更广，必须先统一边界。

records.name: Flinders Street Railway Station - exterior
records.app_visit_scope: Exterior and public area near the main entrance and clocks at Flinders and Swanston Streets; paid platforms are excluded.
records.scope_zh: 钟楼主入口周边公共外部；不含付费区和站台
records.summary_zh: 未找到该入口外部公共空间的官方人数上限。

sources.title: City of Melbourne · Flinders Street Railway Station

records.limitations_zh: 官方提到站前空间扩建 130 平方米，这是扩建面积而非现有总面积或人数容量；站内客流与站台容量均不适用于本记录。

records.name: Federation Square - public plaza
records.app_visit_scope: Federation Square public plaza; ACMI and NGV Australia are separate attractions, so their interior facilities should not be double-counted.
records.scope_zh: 室外主广场；ACMI 与 NGV Australia 另列
records.summary_zh: 现行 Main Square 页为 10,000 人；2022-06-30 官方文章为最多 8,000 人。
records.limitations_zh: 范围最接近软件广场记录，但两份官方资料不一致，未找到足以确认差异原因与适用年份的证据。不能擅自认定 2024/2025 应用哪一数值；活动上限也不是舒适程度阈值。

records.name: Hosier Lane
records.app_visit_scope: Hosier Lane between Flinders Street and Flinders Lane, primarily for outdoor street-art viewing.
records.scope_zh: Flinders Street 至 Flinders Lane 的户外涂鸦街段
records.summary_zh: 未找到该户外街段公开核定人数。

sources.title: City of Melbourne · Street art walk
City of Melbourne · Street art policy 2026

records.limitations_zh: 年访客量不能作为同时在场容量；相邻餐厅、Forum Theatre 或伦敦同名街道的容量均排除。通道、门口与应急出口需按实际范围保留。
